description: This file defines the UnixSocketConnectionListener class which manages Unix domain socket connections, including binding, accepting incoming connections asynchronously, and disposal, within a testing framework for Orleans.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
classes.description: Implements a connection listener over Unix domain sockets for Orleans testing, providing methods to bind, accept connections asynchronously, and clean up resources.

methods.name: UnixSocketConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket listener with endpoint, options, trace, and schedulers.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix domain socket, starts listening with a backlog of 512.

methods.name: AcceptAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts an incoming socket connection, creates a SocketConnection, and starts it, handling exceptions to signal completion.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Disposes the socket and memory pool, signaling unbinding.
